title_en: C-QIN-001: Rat Observation at Shangcai - Cross-Cultural Strategic Selection
description_en: Observe individual performance in different cultural environments to identify the decisive role of cultural environment on personal development, making optimal strategic choices.

title_en: C-QIN-002: Xunzi Transformation Theory - Imperial Art Practice Method
description_en: Transform moral philosophy into operable political technology, reinterpreting theories based on practical political needs to convert 'Kingly Way' into 'Imperial System'.

title_en: C-QIN-003: Guest Memorial Strategy - Cross-Cultural Persuasion
description_en: Use reductio ad absurdum to reveal policy logical contradictions, leveraging accepted practices to expose inherent contradictions and achieve cross-cultural persuasion.

title_en: C-QIN-004: County System Design - Centralization Engineering
description_en: Abolish enfeoffment system, establish county-level administrative structure with three mutually checking positions to achieve centralization and local checks.

title_en: C-QIN-005: Script Unification Method - Cultural Identity Engineering
description_en: Develop unified writing standards to establish cross-regional cultural identity by eliminating regional cultural differences, providing cultural foundation for political unification.

title_en: C-QIN-006: Book Burning Strategy - Information Control Theory
description_en: Control information circulation to unify ideological thinking, establishing knowledge monopoly system of 'using officials as teachers and laws as teachings'.
application_area: Knowledge management and information freedom balance

title_en: C-QIN-007: Realpolitik Method - Political Survival Theory
description_en: In extreme political environments, moral principles yield to survival needs, maintaining political influence through flexible political calculations.

title_en: C-QIN-008: Guest Official Employment Method - Open Talent Strategy
description_en: Advocate open attitude toward employing external talents, treating all worthy individuals equally regardless of origin, achieving cross-cultural governance.

title_en: C-QIN-009: Institutional Inheritance Method - Qin System Continuation
description_en: Good institutional design has enduring value beyond political survival, with 'Qin System' becoming the basic framework inherited by subsequent dynasties.

title_en: C-QIN-010: Five Vermin Criticism Method - Social Purification
description_en: Identify and eliminate 'non-productive' social strata, concentrating national resources on the two core areas of agriculture and warfare.
